method: Three alternating native/baseline/stable rounds, fresh sequential processes after builds/tests finished. Other host activity uncontrolled. Aggregate latency is nearest-rank median of per-process medians, matching source percentile semantics. Every process wrapped with /usr/bin/time -l; Darwin getrusage ru_maxrss is bytes. Peak RSS is the maximum reported process resident set over the complete invocation, not JavaScript heapUsed or summed memory of a process tree. Only this interaction workload is measured, not the complete benchmark gate.
